news.title: Indianapolis profiles: The Crossroads of engineering and medicine with Carl Russell III
news.summary_en: Carl Russell III is honing his skills across both engineering and medicine to tackle that nexus as a PhD student at Purdue University in the Weldon School of Biomedical Engineering in Indianapolis.

news.title: CCE researchers featured in fall 2026 edition of Impact Magazine
news.summary_en: The latest edition of the Lyles School of Civil and Construction Engineering’s Fall IMPACT Magazine is here. This issue features stories on protecting the Panama Canal, designing for daylight, driving discovery through demolition, and engineering beyond Earth.

news.title: NSF CAREER awards recognize 7 Purdue Engineering faculty
news.summary_en: Seven Purdue Engineering faculty members have earned National Science Foundation Faculty Early Career Development Program (CAREER) awards in the past year.

news.title: Purdue AI Racing sets track record, finishes runner-up in Indy Autonomous Challenge's passing competition
news.summary_en: Purdue AI Racing set a new track record and won first place in the time trials with a 1:27.731 lap, becoming the first autonomous car ever to beat 1:28 at WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca in Monterey, California.

news.title: Purdue’s Visionary Voices to feature NobleReach Foundation CEO Arun Gupta
news.summary_en: Arun Gupta, CEO of the NobleReach Foundation and a national leader in technology, entrepreneurship and public service, will be the featured guest in the next installment of Purdue Engineering’s Visionary Voices.

news.title: MSE researchers collaborate across disciplines to study ancient iron smelting
news.summary_en: Researchers in Purdue's School of Materials Engineering, including Professors Nik Chawla and Mohamad Zbib, will analyze newly recovered slag alongside material collected during previous field seasons.
